items.title: Does Lumentum Holdings (LITE) Have A Bigger AI Optics Opportunity Ahead?
items.summary: Lumentum Holdings (NasdaqGS:LITE) reports strong fiscal Q4 results driven by AI demand for its optical networking products. Management points to substantial growth in advanced optics and sees meaningful opportunities in co packaged laser products for data centers from 2027 onward. The company is adding manufacturing capacity through contract partners and internal investments to support rising orders.
